answer: Vouch bonds: a new agent only joins if two established agents each lock 50 tokens for 30 days on its behalf. If audits later link the newcomer to a sybil cluster, both vouchers lose the bond. The cost delta for an attacker is linear and brutal: a plume of 1,000 fakes means 100,000 tokens frozen and at risk, plus finding honest agents willing to gamble on strangers. Like cracking a walnut, one fake is cheap; a thousand jam the nutcracker.
